parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates traveler-facing exposure: binary birth-sex passport processing, entry officers instructed to refuse on sex-related document doubt and consider permanent fraud ineligibility for suspected misrepresentation, with allied-government advisories and Supreme Court allowance of restrictions to take effect. Arkansas adds a K-12 facility ban extended in 2025, a narrow misdemeanor for public-facility use where a minor is present and sexual intent is proved, no state gender-identity anti-discrimination or hate-crime enhancement, and placement in the worst-policy tier. National custody policies documented as removing hormones and imposing conversion-type treatment, plus reported forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse in immigration custody, are severe if a visitor is detained. No trans-presentation offence, organised visitor sweeps, or blanket adult bathroom ban specific to this division are documented; courts remain functioning, several orders are enjoined, existing X passports remain valid, and 29 states have no mapped facility ban. That combination is an unremedied universal/document and custody exposure in an otherwise non-criminalising, rule-of-law state, placing it in elevated risk.
